title: lithocarpus blumeanus
intro: Lithocarpus blumeanus, commonly known as the Sumatran tanoak, is a species of plant in the beech family, Fagaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The health benefits of Lithocarpus blumeanus are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
